items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: The interviewer mentions Nardscog records and a recording machine, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or interaction.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right. I've never heard the records.
Down in Los Angeles, we were talking about those Nardscog records. They say he's still living and still has that same old recording machine that you made your first records on.
